name: [🌋] Timber! 🌲🪓
desc:
👋 Welcome to Timber! 🌲

🚨USE CODE: SUMMER26

🪓 Chop down trees!
🌱 Move them to your plot!
💰 Earn $ to buy new axes! 
🦫 Hatch tree-chopping beavers!
🏗️ Build machines and expand your empire!

✨ 300+ Rare Trees to find!

HOW TO CHOP:
🍀 Walk up to a tree and click/tap to chop! Aim for green for increased luck! Or turn on Auto Chop to cut without the clicks!

Made with ❤️ by Juno & Robbie
